metadata.description: Excursion Example A: +50V, BK125, 4800 W OPL-MAX. A large accelerator whose transient behavior is materially better than the Base Specification Section 10.1.4 ceiling, and which declares that rather than leaving a platform to assume the worst. At 10 us the specification permits 3.00 and this card declares 2.60; at 10 ms the specification permits 2.0004 and this card declares 1.55. Across eight such cards on a shared primary power path that difference is the whole budget. This file is pretty-printed for review. A real CID is minified.
